research_status: COMPLETE — all 1168 episodes of One Piece classified canon/filler/mixed. Sourced from a community-compiled Reddit breakdown, independently corroborated by a second Reddit thread with an identical canon/mixed/filler breakdown, cross-checked against a Crunchyroll/Anime Filler List skippable-filler guide which agreed on every episode except one (807, resolved in favor of the two-source Reddit agreement). Complete, gap-free, non-overlapping coverage of 1-1168 confirmed before writing this file, including a corrected transcription slip (episode 1084, initially pasted as a stray “10”, confirmed as filling the single gap in the manga-canon range between 1083 and 1085).

episodes.status_note: Cross-source disagreement resolved here: two independent Reddit threads both classify this episode as mixed canon/filler, while the Crunchyroll/Anime Filler List cross-reference doesn't list it in either non-canon category (implying canon). Going with mixed, 2 sources vs 1 — same precedent as Bleach episode 227 — everything else between the two sources already agreed exactly.
